violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection the caregiver left in charge was not able to produce records requested by the licensing inspector.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection the caregiver left in charge was not able to produce records requested by the licensing inspector.

At the time of the inspection the site director did not arrive until after the children were released from school. A caregiver was present but did not set any items up in preparation for the arrival of the children. The children were not signed in at arrival.
